Mapping of tokens that failed to transfer properly and can be claimed later\n     * @dev Maps user address -> token address -> claimable amount\n     */\n    mapping(address => mapping(IERC20 => indexed nativeToken, address indexed wrapper, uint256 indexed amount);\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Emitted when stuck tokens are claimed\n     * @param user Address of the user claiming tokens\n     * _tokenManagerERC20 Address of the token manager contract\n     * @dev Sets up the core components needed for interchain transfers\n     */\n    constructor(IInterchainRegistry _interchainRegistry, ITokenManagerERC20 _tokenManagerERC20) {\n        if (address(_tokenManagerERC20) == address(0)) revert TokenManagerInitFailed();\n        if (address(_interchainRegistry) == address(0)) revert RegistryInitFailed();\n        \n        tokenManagerERC20 = _tokenManagerERC20;\n        interchainRegistry = _interchainRegistry;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Executes a token transfer across chains\n     * @dev Internal function to be called by inheriting contracts\n     * @param user Address of the user initiating the transfer\n     * @param sourceToken Address of the token being transferred\n     * @param destinationChainHash Identifier hash of the destination chain\n     * @param amount Amount of tokens to transfer\n     */\n    function _executeInterchainTranfer(address user, address sourceToken, bytes32 destinationChainHash, uint256 amount)\n        internal\n    {\n        if (user == address(0) || sourceToken == address(0) || amount == 0) revert InvalidParameters();\n        \n        // If destination chain is not specified, do nothing\n        if (destinationChainHash == bytes32(0)) {\n            return;\n        }\n        \n        IInterchainRegistry.SupportedToken memory interchainSupportedToken =\n            interchainRegistry.getTokenByRoute(destinationChainHash, sourceToken);\n            \n        // If token is not supported on destination chain, store for later claiming\n        if (!interchainSupportedToken.supported) {\n            claimableTokens[user][IERC20(sourceToken)] = amount;\n            return;\n        }\n        \n        address interchainTokenAddress = sourceToken;\n        \n        // If token needs wrapping before transfer\n        if (interchainSupportedToken.supported && interchainSupportedToken.hasWrapper) {\n            _wrapTokens(user, IERC20(sourceToken), IERC20Wrapper(interchainSupportedToken.wrapper), amount);\n            interchainTokenAddress = interchainSupportedToken.wrapper;\n            IERC20Wrapper(interchainSupportedToken.wrapper).approve(address(tokenManagerERC20), amount);\n        }\n        \n        // Execute the cross-chain // Step 2: Attempt deposit without reverting\n        bool depositSuccess;\n        try wrapper.depositFor(address(this), amount) returns (bool success) {\n            depositSuccess = success;\n        } catch {\n            depositSuccess = false;\n        }\n\n        if (!depositSuccess) {\n            claimableTokens[user][sourceToken] = amount;\n            emit FailedToWrap(address(sourceToken), address(wrapper), amount);\n            // Reset approval to 0 to avoid dangling approvals\n            sourceToken.approve(address(wrapper), 0);\n        }\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Allows users to claim tokens that failed to transfer in previous operations\n     * @param to Address to send the claimed tokens\n     * @param token Token to claim\n }\n}","keccak256":"0x04bd8073b35470bc49c9245d51ba3fd18ce2c46a5bdc6055e5907f8e73ba3d50","license":"BUSL-1.1"},"contracts/native/LayerZeroMessageTracker.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: uint256 actualAmount);\nerror TokenSupplyInsufficentForChain(uint256 expectedAmount, uint256 actualAmount, uint256 layerZeroDstEid);\nerror SupplyInbalance(address token, uint256 countedSupply, uint256 expectedSupply);\n\ncontract NativeSkaleStation is SKALEOApp, AccessControl, ReentrancyGuard, InterchainRouter, LayerZeroMessageTracker {\n    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;\n    using SafeERC20 for IMonorailNativeToken;\n\n    bytes32 public constant MANAGER_ROLE = keccak256(\"MANAGER_ROLE\");\n\n    address private feeCollector;\n    IFeeManager public feeManager;\n\n    /// @notice any monorail tokens should have a list of supported endpoints\n    /// @dev this is used in conjunction with supportedEndpoints to properly balance supply\n    mapping(IMonorailNativeToken => uint32[]) public endpointsByToken;\n\n    /// @notice this is the total amount of supply for a given token [on the SKALE Side]\n    mapping(IMonorailNativeToken => uint256) public supplyAvailable;\n\n    /// @notice SKALE Token -> LayerZero Dest. Endpoint Id -> Total Supply\n    mapping(IMonorailNativeToken => mapping(uint32 => uint256)) public supplyAvailableByChain;\n\n    /// @notice Native Token -> LayerZero Dest. Endpoint Id -> Supported Bool\n    /// @dev While this is technically a duplicate of above, it helps when there is no active balance\n    mapping(IMonorailNativeToken => mapping(uint32 => bool)) public supported;\n\n    /// @notice LayerZero Chain Id => Origin Token => Local Native Token\n    /// @dev This extra mapping is insurance on the exit bridge to ensure that an incorrect\n    /// value is not inputted for the origin tokne that is being exited too\n    mapping(uint32 => mapping(address => IMonorailNativeToken)) public tokens;\n\n    event AddToken(\n        uint32 indexed layerZeroEndpointId, address indexed originTokenAddress, address indexed localTokenAddress\n    );\n    event BridgeReceived(address indexed token, address indexed to, uint256 indexed amount);\n    event InterchainRouteNotSupported(bytes32 indexed finalChainDestination, address indexed nativeToken);\n\n    event SupplyImbalance(address indexed nativeToken, uint256 indexed countedSupply, uint256 indexed expectedSupply);\n\n    constructor(\n        address _layerZeroEndpoint,\n        address _feeCollector,\n        IFeeManager _feeManager,\n        IInterchainRegistry _interchainRegistry,\n        ITokenManagerERC20 _tokenManagerERC20\n    ) SKALEOApp(_layerZeroEndpoint) InterchainRouter(_interchainRegistry, _tokenManagerERC20) {\n        _grantRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, _msgSender());\n        _grantRole(MANAGER_ROLE, _msgSender());\n\n        if (_feeCollector == address(0)) {\n            revert(\"Fee Collector Address Must Not Be 0\");\n        }\n\n        // Set Fee Collector. If failed to set will revert when minting\n        feeCollector = _feeCollector;\n        feeManager = _feeManager;\n    }\n\n    function addToken(uint32 layerZeroEndpointId, address originTokenAddress, address localTokenAddress)\n        external\n        onlyRole(MANAGER_ROLE)\n    {\n        if (address(tokens[layerZeroEndpointId][originTokenAddress]) != address(0)) {\n            revert(\"Token Already Added + Active\");\n        }\n\n        IMonorailNativeToken localToken = IMonorailNativeToken(localTokenAddress);\n\n        // 1 -> Add Support for Token\n        // Local Token === Address on this chain\n        // LayerZeroEndpointId === Destination Id\n        supported[localToken][layerZeroEndpointId] = true;\n\n        // 2 -> Add Cross Chain Address Mapping to Ensure Proper Linking\n        // LayerZeroEndpointId === Destination Id\n        // Origin Token Address === Address on the origin chain\n        // Local Token === Address on this chain\n        tokens[layerZeroEndpointId][originTokenAddress] = localToken;\n\n        // 3 -> Add Endpoint to token bucket\n        // LayerZeroEndpointId === Destination Id\n        // Local Token === Address on this chain\n        endpointsByToken[localToken].push(layerZeroEndpointId);\n\n        emit AddToken(layerZeroEndpointId, originTokenAddress, localTokenAddress);\n    }\n\n    function bridge(\n        uint32 destinationLayerZeroEndpointId,\n        LibTypesV1.TripDetails memory details,\n        MessagingFee memory fee,\n        bytes calldata options\n    ) external nonReentrant returns (MessagingReceipt memory receipt) {\n        IMonorailNativeToken nativeToken = IMonorailNativeToken(details.token);\n\n        // 1 Validate Token is Supported\n        if (!supported[nativeToken][destinationLayerZeroEndpointId]) {\n            revert(\"Token Not Supported\");\n        }\n\n        // 2 Explicit Check Occurs here. Without getFeeBreakdown throws arithmetic underflow/overflow error\n        if (details.amount > nativeToken.balanceOf(_msgSender())) {\n            revert InsufficentBalance(details.amount, nativeToken.balanceOf(_msgSender()));\n        }\n\n        // 3 Calculate FeeBreakdown\n        (uint256 userAmount, uint256 protocolFee) =\n            feeManager.getFeeBreakdown(details.amount, _msgSender(), nativeToken.decimals());\n\n        // 4 Check Supply of Token\n        if (userAmount > supplyAvailable[nativeToken]) {\n            // Is this check necessary?\n            revert TokenSupplyInsufficent(userAmount, supplyAvailable[nativeToken]);\n        }\n\n        // 5 Check Supply by Chain\n        if (userAmount > supplyAvailableByChain[nativeToken][destinationLayerZeroEndpointId]) {\n            revert TokenSupplyInsufficentForChain(\n                userAmount,\n                supplyAvailableByChain[nativeToken][destinationLayerZeroEndpointId],\n                destinationLayerZeroEndpointId\n            );\n        }\n\n        // Reduce Supply\n        supplyAvailable[nativeToken] -= userAmount;\n        supplyAvailableByChain[nativeToken][destinationLayerZeroEndpointId] -= userAmount;\n\n        // 7 User Transfers Tokens to Contract\n        nativeToken.safeTransferFrom(_msgSender(), address(this), details.amount);\n\n        // 8 Transfer Protocol Fee to Fee Collector\n        nativeToken.safeTransfer(feeCollector, protocolFee);\n\n        // 9 Burn User Amount of Native Tokens that will be unlocked on destination\n        nativeToken.burn(userAmount);\n\n        // 10 Book balance Check -> remove?\n        // (bool isBalanced, uint256 countedSupply, uint256 availableSupply) = isSupplyBalanced(nativeToken);\n        // if (!isBalanced) {\n        //     revert SupplyInbalance(address(nativeToken), countedSupply, availableSupply);\n        // }\n\n        // 11 Send LZ Message -> Reminder MUST APPROVE SKL Token for Proper Fee Amount\n        bytes memory _payload = abi.encode(details.token, details.to, userAmount, bytes32(0));\n        receipt = _lzSend(destinationLayerZeroEndpointId, _payload, options, fee, msg.sender);\n    }\n\n    function quote(uint32 dstEid, LibTypesV1.TripDetails memory tripDetails, bytes memory options, bool payInLzToken)\n        public\n        view\n        returns (MessagingFee memory fee)\n    {\n        bytes memory payload = abi.encode(tripDetails);\n        fee = _quote(dstEid, payload, options, payInLzToken);\n    }\n\n    function _mintTokens(IMonorailNativeToken nativeToken, address receiver, uint256 amount, uint32 sourceEndpointId)\n        internal\n        returns (uint256, uint256)\n    {\n        (uint256 userAmount, uint256 protocolFee) = feeManager.getFeeBreakdown(amount, receiver, nativeToken.decimals());\n\n        emit BridgeReceived(address(nativeToken), receiver, userAmount);\n\n        supplyAvailable[nativeToken] += amount;\n        supplyAvailableByChain[nativeToken][sourceEndpointId] += amount;\n\n        // End Supply Balance Section\n        // Should these be moved before the state changes?\n        nativeToken.mint(receiver, userAmount);\n        nativeToken.mint(feeCollector, protocolFee);\n\n        return (userAmount, protocolFee);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @dev Called when data is received from the protocol. It overrides the equivalent function in the parent contract.\n     * Protocol messages are defined as packets, comprised of the following parameters.\n     * @param _origin A struct containing information about where the packet came from.\n     * @param _guid A global unique identifier for tracking the packet.\n     * @param payload Encoded message.\n     */\n    function _lzReceive(\n        Origin calldata _origin,\n        bytes32 _guid,\n        bytes calldata payload,\n        address,\n        bytes calldata\n    ) internal virtual override nonReentrant {\n        _processMessage(_guid);\n        LibTypesV1.TripDetails memory data = abi.decode(payload, (LibTypesV1.TripDetails));\n\n        IMonorailNativeToken nativeToken = tokens[_origin.srcEid][data.token];\n\n        if (data.interchainDestination == bytes32(0)) {\n            _mintTokens(nativeToken, data.to, data.amount, _origin.srcEid);\n        } else {\n            (uint256 userAmount, uint256 protocolFee) = feeManager.getFeeBreakdown(data.amount, address(this), nativeToken.decimals());\n            supplyAvailable[nativeToken] += data.amount;\n            supplyAvailableByChain[nativeToken][_origin.srcEid] += data.amount;\n            nativeToken.mint(address(this), userAmount);\n            nativeToken.mint(feeCollector, protocolFee);\n            _executeInterchainTranfer(data.to, address(nativeToken), data.interchainDestination, userAmount);\n        }\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0xf435762876ce8181ebe6af50631bb97b7c0e344900eeb2e7002ece9e1955b618","license":"BUSL-1.1"}},"version":1}
